summary: Firefox replaced its old online Web Speech recognition path with local, on-device recognition based on the Parakeet engine, the HWInference process, and downloadable models managed through ModelHub. The Web Speech API now has more complete standards behavior, including locale-based model selection, `continuous` recognition, model availability and installation, permission prompts with download progress, AI Controls and Permissions Policy checks, and accurate result, confidence, timing, stop, and abort events. Streaming audio is processed in smaller chunks with downmixing, while performance counters, profiler markers, memory reporting, Glean telemetry, and extensive race/fuzz/end-to-end tests make the feature measurable and reliable. **Speech recognition can now keep audio processing locally in the browser instead of sending it to an online service.**
